findings: M633 directly proves current packaged visibility of the operation-specific matrix, core transition projection, and explicit safety boundary.
The matrix is a coverage declaration, not a transition executor, persistent history, authoritative reread, recovery proof, or authority grant.
The eleven producer-family map remains compatible with prior M352 reconciliation; no family is promoted by M633 and no authority domains are collapsed.
All four Stage 11 clauses remain partial because the required runtime lifecycle, commit/reread, recovery, and cross-family evidence is not contradiction-free in one acceptance record.
The current failure-control state is clean: zero recorded failures, recovery mode false, and no Stage 12 or Ready-to-Play claim.

smallestRemainingGap.title: one bounded local-project proposal lifecycle conformance receipt
smallestRemainingGap.scope: Use the existing operation-specific local-project proposal/session paths on one fresh test-owned project to record preview, explicit human approval, one supported apply, authoritative post-apply reread, inverse restore, and append-only history transitions. Bind the exact operation, project identity, base revision/hash, reviewer and target authority, execution receipt, reread, and recovery disposition. Do not add a generic executor or collapse operation-specific authority; stop on unknown outcome until reread; keep providers, credentials, browser storage, repository promotion, Technical Builder, Foundry, player passwords, and Stage 12 outside the boundary.
smallestRemainingGap.reason: The packaged matrix now makes every operation and state inspectable, so the smallest evidence gap is one current end-to-end local lifecycle receipt that connects the existing typed session and operation-specific executor to authoritative reread and inverse recovery without widening authority.
requiredEvidence: fresh test-owned target and exact project identity
no-write preview and explicit human approval
inverse restore with matched reread and append-only history
outcome-unknown stop and no retry before reread
zero provider, credential, browser, repository, Technical Builder, Foundry, player-password, and foreign-state activity

decision.reason: M634 preserves direct packaged operation/history visibility, maps it to all four Stage 11 clauses and eleven producer families, and confirms that lifecycle execution, authoritative reread, recovery, commit, and authority evidence remain incomplete.
